title: Reconstruct apostrophes mis-mapped to space in PDF extraction
description: The SRD PDF font's ToUnicode maps certain apostrophe glyphs to a near-zero-width U+0020 space emitted as a standalone text item, so joinRowText produces 'monster s attack' instead of 'monster’s attack'. Found by PR #227 review (rule:conditions p358). Scope: exactly 7 cases across the PDF, all possessive/contraction at a word boundary — Land's Stride (p35), can't (p232), monster's (p358), Mare's/Lion's/cow's head (p361), Woman's face (p362). Distinguished from 1990 legitimate word-separator zero-width spaces (italic run boundaries like 'System Reference') by the next item beginning with an enclitic (s|t|d|m|re|ve|ll) at a word boundary. Fix in extract.ts joinRowText: when a near-zero-width ' ' item sits between a letter and an enclitic, emit U+2019. Count-neutral (text fidelity only). Add extract.test.ts coverage + rule:conditions sentinel 'a monster’s attack'.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #227 commit 6b2fd4f. extract.ts joinRowText reconstructs U+2019 between a letter and a possessive/contraction enclitic across an apostrophe-sized gap. 7 source-confirmed possessives recovered (monster's, can't, Land's Stride x2, Mare's/Lion's/cow's head, Woman's face); Ranger table cell now refs feature:ranger:lands-stride. joinRowText unit tests + rule:conditions sentinel added. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack + verify:worktree green.
